result.document_summary: A fragment of San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 5, Article 2 (Public Safety, Morals and Welfare), covering remedies, the Due Process and Safety ordinance, targeted residential picketing and drug-loitering provisions.
result.notes: This part of the document contains no rules in the six rental-housing categories (rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, application screening fees, screening restrictions, algorithmic rent setting). Although the source URL slug refers to a division on prohibition of algorithmic rent price fixing, the text actually provided covers unrelated police regulations (Due Process and Safety, picketing, loitering), so no rules were extracted.
